en.name: Turkey bacon
en.summary: Turkey bacon is cured, smoked and formed from chopped turkey meat rather than sliced from a belly, and it must be cooked before eating. Unopened it keeps 2 weeks refrigerated, 7 days once opened, and 2–4 months in the freezer at −18 °C (0 °F). After thawing, use it within the fridge window or by the best-by date on the pack.
en.pantry: Turkey bacon is a chilled product and does not belong in a cupboard. It is leaner than pork bacon and, being formed from chopped meat, it has more surface worked through it, so the cure and smoke buy it fridge life rather than shelf life. Out of the fridge the two-hour rule applies, or one hour above 32 °C (90 °F) — including the strips left in the pan or on a plate after breakfast.
en.fridge: Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. An unopened pack runs 2 weeks from purchase, or to the printed date if that comes first. Once opened you have 7 days: re-wrap the remaining rashers tightly or move them to a sealed box, because an open pack dries at the edges and picks up fridge smells fast. Store it on a shelf rather than the door, keep it away from ready-to-eat food, and cook it through — turkey bacon is raw cured poultry, not a ready-to-eat meat.
en.freezer: It keeps 2–4 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Roll the rashers in pairs or interleave them with baking paper before bagging, so you can take out a couple without thawing the lot, and press the air out. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are a quality limit, and past them the lean meat dries and the smoke tastes flat.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge overnight and then use it within the opened-pack window, or by the best-by date printed on the pack if that comes first. You can also cook the rashers straight from frozen over gentle heat. Never thaw on the counter, and do not refreeze after a full thaw at room temperature.
spoilage: Slime or a tacky film on the rashers.
A sour or ammonia smell rather than a smoky, salty one.
Grey-green patches, or edges gone brown and hard in an open pack.
A pack that is puffy or leaking before it is opened.
tips: Write the opening date on the pack — two weeks and seven days are different clocks.
Freeze in pairs so breakfast does not mean thawing a whole pack.
Cook it a little more gently than pork bacon; there is almost no fat to protect it.
Keep it below and away from anything eaten without cooking.

faq.q: How long does turkey bacon last after opening?
faq.a: 7 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, tightly re-wrapped. Unopened, 2 weeks from purchase.
Yes, 2–4 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Interleave the rashers so you can take out a couple at a time.

faq.q: Does turkey bacon need to be cooked?
faq.a: Yes. It is cured raw poultry, not a ready-to-eat meat, so cook it right through.

zh.name: 火雞培根
zh.summary: 火雞培根是用切碎的火雞肉醃漬、煙燻後成型的產品，不是從腹肉直接切片，而且必須煮熟才能吃。未開封冷藏 2 週，開封後 7 天，冷凍 −18 °C 下 2～4 個月。解凍後請在冷藏期限內、或包裝標示的最佳賞味期限前用完。
zh.pantry: 火雞培根是冷藏品，不該進櫥櫃。它比豬培根瘦，而且是用碎肉成型的，內部被翻動過的表面更多，所以醃漬與煙燻買到的是冷藏壽命而不是常溫壽命。離開冰箱後適用 2 小時原則，室溫超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時——包括早餐後留在鍋裡或盤子上的那幾片。
zh.fridge: 放 4 °C 以下。未開封的包裝從購買日起算 2 週，若標示日期更早則以標示為準。開封後你有 7 天：剩下的要重新包緊或移到密封盒，因為敞開的包裝邊緣很快變乾，也很會吸冰箱的味道。請放層架而不是冰箱門，和即食食品分開，並且要煮透——火雞培根是生的醃製禽肉，不是即食肉品。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下品質可維持 2～4 個月。裝袋前兩片一組捲起來，或用烘焙紙一片片隔開，這樣一次拿兩片就好，不必解凍整包；記得壓出空氣。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數是品質期限；超過之後瘦肉會變乾、煙燻味也變平淡。
zh.thawing: 冷藏隔夜解凍，然後在開封後的期限內用完，或以包裝上的最佳賞味期限為準（以較早者為準）。也可以直接從冷凍用小火慢煎。不要放室溫退冰；室溫下完全退冰後不要再冷凍。
spoilage: 肉片發黏、表面有一層黏膜。
聞起來發酸或有氨味，而不是鹹香的煙燻味。
出現灰綠色斑塊，或開封包裝裡邊緣已經變褐變硬。
還沒開封就已經脹袋或滲液。
tips: 在包裝上寫開封日——兩週和七天是兩套時鐘。
兩片一組冷凍，早餐就不必解凍一整包。
火比煎豬培根再小一點；它幾乎沒有油脂保護。
位置放在所有免加熱食品的下方並保持距離。

faq.q: 火雞培根開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 重新包緊放 4 °C 以下 7 天。未開封則是從購買日起算 2 週。
可以，−18 °C 下 2～4 個月。用紙把肉片隔開，方便一次拿幾片。
需要。它是生的醃製禽肉，不是即食肉品，要煎透再吃。
